title: FarEye Technologies narrows FY26 net loss to ₹9.41 crore on revenue growth
description:
Software-as-a-services company FarEye Technologies has narrowed its net loss to Rs 9.41 crore in FY'26 on a rise in revenues.
The company had reported a net loss of Rs 52.13 crore in FY25.
Revenue from operations rose 24.58 per cent to Rs 247 crore in FY26 from Rs 198 crore in the preceding fiscal year, while total income stood at Rs 265 crore, FarEye Technologies said in a statement.
In the January-March quarter of FY26, the company achieved profitability, FarEye Technologies said on Thursday.
FarEye's cash reserves stood at Rs 270.66 crore at the end of FY26.
International markets, including North America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Asia Pacific, contributed 91.88 per cent of revenue from operations in FY26, it said.
FarEye Co-founder and CEO Kushal Nahata said the FY26 performance was driven by enterprise customer growth, improved operational efficiency and disciplined cost management.
